title: Grilled Salmon Wrap
description: A simple and flavorful wrap filled with grilled salmon, topped with zesty coleslaw and wrapped in a crispy Canadian wrap.
instructions: Season the salmon fillet with salt and pepper.
Grill the salmon for 4-5 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
Meanwhile, wrap the Canadian wrap in a damp paper towel and microwave for 20-30 seconds to warm it up.
Spread 1 tablespoon of mayonnaise on the wrap.
Top the wrap with the grilled salmon, zesty coleslaw mix, and a sprinkle of salt and pepper.
Drizzle with olive oil and fold the wrap in half to serve.
